issue_request: FHIR-5792 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I DSTU1 follow-on to FHIR-5791 asking that the specification build tool fill out and publish ValueSet expansion parameters and other expansion metadata as much as possible, especially code-system/version information. Jira records SVN revision 4551 and a 2015-03-19 MnM/FHIR block vote.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 360171a424a2b0bdbf84d612bc7a722385214254 is SVN revision 4551 and explicitly says '#5792 - fill out value set expansion versions'. It changed the historical Java ValueSetExpanderSimple and terminology service interfaces to pass ValueSet.expansion.parameter lists through expansion generation, add version URI parameters when source or imported value sets had versions, and copy parameter metadata from imported or terminology-service expansions instead of returning only contains entries.
additional_context: The old tools/java publisher implementation touched by SVN 4551 is no longer present in the current FHIR checkout. The current build invokes org.hl7.fhir.tools.publisher.Publisher from the external kindling dependency pinned in gradle.properties. ValueSet remains active current-build source, and later related decisions already on the combined branch cover the same semantic family: FHIR-5791 added expansion.parameter, FHIR-3535 added ValueSet.expansion.contains.version, FHIR-13810/FHIR-41589/FHIR-41639 refined version/accounting guidance, and FHIR-13820 audited the related $expand valueSetVersion parameter.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active ValueSet StructureDefinition, narrative, $expand operation, and example expansion already describe expansion parameters and version metadata, while the historical build-tool implementation is no longer an editable current core source location.
